description: Utility functions for calculating popover dimensions and positions in a web UI, including max height, app rect, and popover rect positioning.

methods.name: getPopoverMaxHeight
methods.description: Calculates the maximum height for a popover based on app and button rectangles, side, alignment, and media query breakpoints.

methods.name: getAppRect
methods.description: Returns the rectangle representing the application area, considering footer height if present.

methods.name: getPositionedPopoverRect
methods.description: Calculates the position of a popover rectangle relative to a button, side, and alignment.
